finding.headline: "The Disrupted-Omugwo"
finding.problem: "The woman here to 'help' criticises how I hold the baby and what I eat. I'm more stressed than before she arrived. This was supposed to be my rest."
finding.person: Mum whose mother-in-law came for omugwo but conflict erupts ("friction between new mother and mother of husband/wife because of conflict in ideas" — Guardian Nigeria); she feels trapped and judged in her own home.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (angles the cultural tradition's dark side) — "When Omugwo Hurts: Resetting the Postpartum Help in Your Home."". Verdict: PASSES.
